text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government meets workers' union representatives and pledges commitment to improve wages.
- Government hails accord with one university teachers' union and urges other university unions to join in talks to end strike over pay.
- Oran's university pays tribute to late president Houari Boumedienne.
- Soccer national squad coach has African cup in his sights.
- Authorities ease currency exchange for students abroad.
